description:
Who is calling: returns the identity and subscription plan of the MCP token in use. No project id needed.

Returns { userId, name, email, organizationId, plan }. plan holds the raw tier and expiry from the token plus the derived limits and permissions the other tools enforce: canWrite (writes allowed at all), sharingAllowed (whether invite_user will work — the app's Share-button rule), isEnterprise (large-project copies), maxProjects and maxNodesPerProject. limitsEnforced reports whether the project-cap and per-project node-cap are currently applied on MCP calls (auto-activates 2026-12-31; sandbox project 8185f7b2bd254d1496c6388cd7dc26e6 exempt). Call it at the start of a session to know your limits before creating or importing.
name: whoami
title: Whoami
